question: What are common errors made by beginner pilots according to the Airplane Flying Handbook (FAA-H-8083-3C) Chapter 3 section on Common Errors?

correct_answers.text: Forgetting the location of preselected reference points on subsequent flights.
Attempting to establish or correct airplane attitude using flight instruments rather than the natural horizon.
Habitually flying with one wing low or maintaining directional control using only the rudder control.

wrong_answers.text: Ignoring air traffic control instructions during flight maneuvers.
Relying solely on GPS navigation for all flight operations.
Neglecting pre-flight checks and aircraft maintenance schedules.
Failing to communicate intentions with other pilots in the vicinity.
Using autopilot features excessively during manual flight training.
Disregarding weight and balance calculations before flight.
Skipping the use of checklists for takeoff and landing procedures.
